economic_rationale: The passive-core structure addresses the repeated opportunity-cost failure of full-cash daily timing states. It is valuable only if lagged relative Ulcer stress preserves at least 70 percent of buy-and-hold upside after costs while materially reducing drawdown, improving Calmar and surviving annual and 21/35-day neighbor breadth. Lower exposure by itself cannot pass.
opportunity_cost: One frozen direct screen tests a new downside-depth-duration and passive-core structure using the existing sealed corpus and fractional ledger. A failure closes it before indicator tuning or runtime engineering consumes more capacity.
stop_conditions: Stop with DATA_REJECT before economics if any source hash, dataset hash, hourly lattice, OHLCV or complete UTC-day gate fails.

Stop with EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT before economics if rolling-window running maximum, squared percentage drawdown averaging, lagged median exclusion, state-change-only fractional rebalancing or next-open availability is ambiguous.
Stop and permanently close the exact daily Ulcer21/28/35 lagged-median 100/50 passive-core family if the primary or either rejection-only neighbor fails any frozen gate.
Do not select a neighbor after seeing outcomes even if it outperforms the primary.
Do not scan another Ulcer lookback, reference window, percentile, exposure, equality, rebalance frequency, delay, hold, stop, DRA combination or cost model after results.
Do not use post-2024 data; a pass may only become CANDIDATE_FROZEN_REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED with one independent sealed OOS still required.
thesis: A causal completed-day Ulcer28 regime overlay can retain a permanent half-size BTC core while reducing the other half during unusually deep and persistent downside paths, improving after-cost risk-adjusted performance over full-capital buy-and-hold without relying on a full-cash timing state.

distinct_from_closed_families: Unlike the closed daily oscillator and trend families, this overlay never goes fully to cash and uses downside path depth plus duration rather than price direction, range location, volume or moving-average state.
Unlike the closed monthly volatility target, it uses downside-only rolling drawdowns, a daily decision clock, a lagged self-relative boundary and only two fixed exposure states.
Unlike DRA drawdown admission gates, it is a standalone whole-portfolio exposure overlay and not a discrete-lot entry veto or exit manager.
excluded_reinterpretations: Ulcer28 is primary; Ulcer21 and Ulcer35 are rejection-only neighbors and cannot replace it.

No alternate lookback, lagged-reference length, percentile, exposure, equality, rebalance frequency, delay, holding rule, stop, leverage, short leg, DRA interaction or ensemble may be scanned after outcome access.
A historical pass remains REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED and still requires one independent sealed OOS.
